verdict.rationale: Paperspace API keys are scoped to a team and can be revoked by the owner or a team admin, which gives coarse credential isolation for an agent. There is no documented per-key permission or least-privilege control: keys carry team-scoped permissions tied to the user account. DigitalOcean's Action Gateway is a separate product and is not credited here. Missing for 10: fine-grained permission scopes per key, read-only or resource-limited keys, key expiry/TTL, agent-specific or service-account credentials, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: API Keys have team-scoped permissions and are associated with your user account.
You can revoke your API keys by clicking revoke in the console.
you can also revoke keys that belong to other team members.
